title: Rock-paper-scissors among three Lenia replicator kinds on one regrowing food: cyclic predation keeps all three kinds with high turnover, the transitive twin suppresses or eliminates the doubly-eaten kind, and the no-predation twin freezes (2/2 seeds)
summary: world.py: three kinds of Chan's MIRd+ (identical 15-kernel rule, separate 3-channel sets, one planted founder each) build matter only from one shared, diffusing, regrowing food (as eco-lenia2: Y 2, decay 0.01, regrowth 0.03); a kind is excluded by every other kind except its own prey, and also builds from its prey's matter within a Gaussian neighbourhood (sigma 4, at most PRATE=1 of the local prey per unit time, mass-conserving) before drawing on food. 160x160, t=0-800, seeds 1-2, cells = core components >= 20 px (runr.py). Cyclic (0 eats 1, 1 eats 2, 2 eats 0): all three kinds persist at 20-23 cells each (t>=400 means; minima 15-19) and 46-51% of occupied pixels change kind every 20 t. Transitive twin (0 eats 1 and 2, 1 eats 2): kind 0 saturates at 33, the doubly-eaten kind 2 falls to 7 (seed 1) and goes extinct (seed 2), turnover 14-21%. No-predation twin: the kinds tile the domain into a static lattice (21-27 each), turnover 13-15% (edge jitter). Before the exclusion was relaxed for prey (first version, mutual exclusion), every arm froze. This is the rubric's L5 pattern with matched twins (same grid, duration, seeds); the predation operator is coded, founders are planted, and the coexistence-vs-domain-size law of the May-Leonard positive control (20261025T2027-c26-rps-control) was not tested here.

finding.operator: cyclic vs transitive predation between three Lenia replicator kinds sharing one food
finding.control: matched transitive and no-predation twins, same grid, duration and seeds (1, 2)
finding.result: cyclic: 20-23 cells per kind, turnover 0.46-0.51; transitive: 33 / 20-28 / 1-8 (kind 2 extinct in seed 2), turnover 0.14-0.21; none: 21-27 each, static, turnover 0.13-0.15

limits: Two seeds, one domain size and one predation rate (a cyclic run at PRATE 3, seed 1, also coexisted: q_cyclic3_s1.png). Founders planted close together (the placement spacing does not fit three founders in 160 px). Kinds are identical apart from the predation matrix. Population counts at t>=400 only; no lineage ledger or spiral-wavelength measure. Predation is a coded transfer of matter, so the interaction is imposed; the finding is about what the cyclic topology does to the population dynamics.
